# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityTrailingStopLossAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)

        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.MINUTE)

        # ATR based on daily price for immediacy of daily bars
        self._spy.atr = self.atr(self._spy.symbol, 14, Resolution.DAILY)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._spy.atr = AverageTrueRange(14)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._spy, self._spy.atr, Resolution.DAILY)
        # self.register_indicator(self._spy.atr, Resolution.DAILY)

        # Track the highest price since entry so we can trail the stop down
        self._spy.entry_high = IndicatorExtensions.minus(
            IndicatorExtensions.max(self._spy.atr, 14), 
            self._spy.atr
        )

        self.plot_indicator("ATR", self._spy.atr)
        self.plot_indicator("Entry High", self._spy.entry_high)
        self.plot_indicator("Stop Loss", self._spy.stop_loss)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if not self._spy.atr.is_ready:
            return

        price = self._spy.price
        atr = self._spy.atr.current.value
        stop_loss_price = price - (3 * atr)

        if not self._spy.invested and price > self._spy.entry_high.current.value:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy.symbol, 1)
            self._spy.stop_loss = stop_loss_price

        if self._spy.invested and price < self._spy.stop_loss:
            self.liquidate()
            self._spy.invested = False
            self._spy.stop_loss = None
